Thanks Marcus — quick answers inline.

Auto-renew confirmation: this is a Procurement policy — we need an auditable confirmation step. It can be a one-click acknowledgment from procurement@brightframe.com but must generate an email record and an editable timestamp in our system. We prefer "opt-in by confirmation" rather than automatic renewal if confirmation is not completed; our legal team wants the option to place the subscription into a 30-day hold before auto-renew (not immediate renewal).

TFC: BrightFrame is open to 45 days for transition assistance but wants a cap on liability for costs directly tied to offboarding (e.g., data export, basic export scripts, and S3 egress). Our counsel will propose specific language.

We'll review the redline and get back with suggested tweaks by end of week.

Marcus — thanks, noted. A few internal points before we respond formally to BrightFrame counsel: 

- The "one-click confirmation" is operationally feasible but needs a formal definition in the order form: who can click (Procurement email alias only?), what constitutes a valid confirmation (timestamp + originating IP + human-readable note?), and what the fallback behavior is (30-day hold, notification to account team, pause of auto-charge).

- On TFC: we can accept 45 days transition assistance for the pilot only, with a standard 60-day baseline for enterprise commitments. For liability cap on offboarding costs, we should propose an explicit carve-out in the order form limited to "reasonable and documented third-party egress costs" and specify that professional services billed for complex exports remain billable at standard rates.

- We should not accept a permanent reduction of the baseline TFC for enterprise deals; keep pilot exception language tied to deal_id BF-2026-8342 and expiry date.

I'll draft suggested language for the MSA redline (comments) and a short order-form addendum that captures the confirmation workflow (e.g., Section 2.3: Renewal Confirmation — "Customer must deliver affirmative confirmation in writing via the procurement alias no less than 30 days prior to renewal; absent confirmation, subscription will enter a 30-day hold and billing will not occur until confirmation or hold lapse.").
